review_process.limitation: AI-only review with possible shared-model correlated errors; no human or customer claim.

scope_resolution.observed_github_operational_readiness: The captured GitHub PR state is open/non-draft and reports mergeable=true with clean merge state. This is a bounded API observation; it alone is insufficient where mandatory policy discovery remains incomplete.
scope_resolution.conservative_readiness: Ready when the captured open PR has coherent repository/head/base-ref identity, sufficient applicable branch-policy discovery, observably satisfied mandatory requirements, and no material unknown or confirmed blocker. Unknown when a necessary mandatory-policy fact remains unestablished. No unstated rule requires PR-associated base SHA to equal contemporaneous branch-tip SHA.
scope_resolution.scoped_assurance: Pass means sufficient captured evidence supports the applicable mandatory GitHub requirements within this bounded snapshot. It is not exact-parent provenance for every test merge, product testing, release safety, or actor-specific permission signoff. Stronger base-specific attribution would require an explicit requirement and evidence scope; none is added here.
scope_resolution.pre_output_semantic_correction: Both independent originals labeled all cases unknown. Cross-review found their jq identity rationale had imposed a stronger exact-current-base attribution prerequisite than the original scope requires. The originals are preserved; the two jq cases are corrected to ready/pass before any candidate output.
